title: fix(app-shell): the condition builder's is-empty / is-not-empty compile a null-or-empty check on a non-boolean field, and the Rules tab passes field types (objectui#11894)
body:
Fixes #11894

Clause-②: no

## What this changes

Studio's condition builder typed none of its value-less operators. *is true / set* compiled to the bare subject and *is false / empty* to `!` plus the subject, whatever the field was. CEL's `!`, and a bare `&&` operand, take a bool. So on a date, text or lookup field the predicate could not be evaluated, and a server-evaluated condition refused the write it guarded. The benchmark rule (`record.status == 'done' && !record.due_date`) refused every write to a done ticket with `no such overload: !null`, or `!string` when the ticket had a due date.

`ConditionBuilder` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ConditionBuilder.tsx`):

- **Typed by the field catalog.** A subject's value is read from its catalog row:
  - `boolean` when the type is in the spec's `BOOLEAN_VALUE_TYPES` (by reference);
  - otherwise the row of the ruled "is empty" table that the spec's `expandEmptyOperator({ type, multiple })` assigns it. No local copy of the table.
- **Boolean field:** reads *is true* / *is false* and compiles as before (`S` / `!S`).
- **Any other declared field:** reads *is not empty* / *is empty* and compiles to a null-or-empty check:
  - `null_only`: `S == null` / `S != null`;
  - `text`: `S == null || S == ''` and its complement;
  - `multi_value`: `S == null || size(S) == 0` and its complement;
  - a check of more than one clause is parenthesised when it is joined with other rows.
- **Undeclared subject** (a context subject, a flow variable, a catalog row with no type): keeps today's words and today's form. Nothing on the row says which check it needs, and the dispatch ruled against guessing.
- **`formula` field:** undeclared on purpose. Its value takes its `returnType`, which no catalog row carries. This follows the spec's own boolean comparand door, which defers a formula without a readable `returnType`. It also keeps "is true" on a boolean formula compiling as it did.
- **New row:** *Add condition* seeds `equals` instead of `truthy`. `S == ''` is well typed for every value.
- **`parse` and stored conditions:**
  - `parse` reads every new emission back into the row it was built as. It splits at top-level joins and respects parentheses and string literals. A lone compound check reads as one row, not two comparisons.
  - A stored `!field` on a typed non-boolean field no longer round-trips, so it opens in the raw editor exactly as written. This is the component's existing round-trip-or-raw rule, and the same non-retroactive shape `ConditionBuilder.referenceValue.test.tsx` pins. ⛔ No silent rewrite on load or on a later edit.
- **Fetched catalogs.** When a catalog fetched by `objectName` lands after the first render, the stored value is re-read under the declared types, unless the author has already edited it. A builder-made check then reopens as rows, and a stored `!field` opens in the raw editor, the same way at a mount that fetches its fields as at one that is handed them.
- **Why `== null` and not `has()`:** the server evaluates a validation rule or a hook condition over a record whose declared fields are all present. A field with no value holds `null`, so `has()` is true for an empty field. objectql's rule-validator contract says the same: test emptiness with `!= null`, and keep `has()` for an undeclared key. Measured with the formula engine: `has(record.due_date)` on `{ due_date: null }` is `true`.

Four new designer rows (en, zh) in `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`: `engine.inspector.condition.op.isTrue` / `isFalse` / `isNotEmpty` / `isEmpty`. The two existing rows stay for undeclared subjects. No language-pack key, no export, no published type member: `ConditionBuilder.d.ts` is not reachable from `dist/index.d.ts` (declaration-graph walk over the published 17.7.0 tarball; `SchemaForm.d.ts` reached, as the control).

## The in-place producer change: the Studio Rules tab

The benchmark's own mount handed the builder no types. `ObjectValidationsPanel`'s `FieldOpt` carried `{ name, label, hidden }` only, so every field there read as undeclared and the rule still saved as `!record.due_date`. `FieldOpt` now carries `type` and `multiple`. Its `fields` memo copies `e.def.type` when it is a string, and `multiple: e.def.multiple === true`, the shape `useObjectFields` and `ResourceEditPage` already read.

The claim was amended for exactly this: card comment 6055312520 adds `FieldOpt` and the `fields` memo of `studio-design/ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx`, plus one pin beside it, to the File surface. No other region of that file differs from `main`.

The other mounts already passed the type: hook condition, action visible / disabled, page-block visibility and flow conditions through `useObjectFields`, and the schema-form condition widget through `ResourceEditPage`'s catalog. None of them passes `multiple`, so the changeset says where the multi-value arm reaches a multi-capable type.

## Evidence (head `ec8411f3`)

Pins evaluate the CEL the builder emits with `@objectstack/formula`'s `ExpressionEngine.evaluate(expr, { record, previous })`, the call objectql's `checkPredicate` makes:

- `ConditionBuilder.typedEmptyOps-11894.test.tsx` (26 tests):
  - the benchmark rule on a date field is true with no due date and false with one;
  - text "is empty" is true for `''` and for null;
  - the multi-value arm on `tags`, and on a lookup with `multiple: true` against a single lookup;
  - controls: a boolean compiles as before; an undeclared field and a formula keep `!S` / `S`;
  - lossless round trip for eight shapes; a new row seeds `equals`; the fetched-catalog re-read;
  - instrument control: the old emission faults (`no such overload`) in the same engine, both ways.
- `ObjectValidationsPanel.typedEmptyOps-11894.test.tsx` (5 tests), mounting the Rules tab:
  - building "due date is empty" writes `record.status == 'done' && record.due_date == null`, which evaluates true with no due date and false with one;
  - that rule reloads as the "is empty" row;
  - the old builder's `!record.due_date` opens in the raw editor verbatim;
  - a lookup declared `multiple` builds "is empty" as `record.status == 'done' && (record.watchers == null || size(record.watchers) == 0)`, which evaluates true for `[]` and for null and false for a member;
  - control: a boolean field on the same draft writes `!record.urgent` / `record.urgent`.

Ablations, each through objectstack `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode. Each mutation was proven on disk (anchor count and blob), and each restore was proven: the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. No build leg in either: both pins import the subject by relative path, not through a package export.

- `compileRow`'s falsy arm emits `!S` again (at `d235d45`): the builder pin went **10 failed / 16 passed**, the date pin among the reds. Expected direction: red.
- The `type` copy is dropped from the Rules tab memo (at `ec8411f3`): the panel pin went **5 failed / 5**, the benchmark pin among the reds. The `multiple` pin and the boolean control are red too: without a type every field there reads as undeclared, and the operators are worded by type.
- The `multiple` copy is dropped from the same memo (at `4cc894f`): **1 failed / 4 passed**. The red one is the `multiple` pin (received `record.status == 'done' && record.watchers == null`). That line is unchanged since.

- Tests at `00a030d`, before the later merges of `main`, under the shared verify lock: **374 files / 3416 tests passed**. The set is every app-shell test whose import closure reaches `ConditionBuilder.tsx`, plus the app-shell tests that read the designer i18n table. The closure is derived from static relative imports, `import()`, side-effect imports and `vi.mock` specifiers, so it is blind to a test that reaches the builder through a package specifier or reads sources from disk.
- Tests at `ec8411f3`, after merging `main` `1c51e973`: **17 files / 177 tests passed**. They are every `ObjectValidationsPanel*.test.tsx`, every `ConditionBuilder*.test.tsx` (objectui#11895 changed nine of them), and `useObjectFields.draftOverlay-11895`. The full package suite is CI's.
- `Bundle Analysis` on `ec8411f3`: success. Console Performance Budget: eager closure 3308.0 KB gzip (336 chunks) against a budget of 3312.0 KB, PASS; main entry chunk 71.3 KB against 350 KB.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0 at `ec8411f3`, after a turbo build of its dependency closure. It runs `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` too, which types both new test files.
- `pnpm exec eslint`: 0 errors at `ec8411f3`. Across the panel and both pins there is 1 warning, in the panel: the pre-existing `set-state-in-effect` that `main`'s own `ObjectValidationsPanel.tsx` blob carries. `ConditionBuilder.tsx` carries the 7 warnings of its baseline (measured at `d235d45`; the file is unchanged since).
- `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`: all exit 0 at `ec8411f3`.
- `check:spec-floors`: NOT MEASURED locally (it needs a workspace build). The fact it judges was read directly: `@objectstack/spec@17.6.0`, app-shell's declared floor, exports `BOOLEAN_VALUE_TYPES`, `expandEmptyOperator` and `EmptyOperatorArm` from `./data`.
- The full app-shell package suite and a browser pass are NOT MEASURED locally; CI runs the farm. The eager budget is the Bundle Analysis reading above.

## Acceptance notes

- class: a · reach: named producer: Studio ConditionBuilder's compare rows (greater than, less than, and the at-least / at-most symbols) emit an unguarded ordering comparison such as record.amount greater-than 100; evaluated with @objectstack/formula ExpressionEngine.evaluate on a record whose amount is null it faults (no such overload: dyn of null greater-than int), and a date field does the same, so a server-evaluated validation rule built that way refuses every write where the field is empty (fail-closed) · evidence: engine probe at objectui d235d45 with formula 17.7.0; the objectql rule-validator docblock records that ordering comparisons still fault over a total record and that a lint null-guard gate exists for it · dedupe words: condition builder greater than null field no such overload · ConditionBuilder ordering operator null guard · validation rule compare empty field refuses write
- carrier: this branch's next round (or the PR author) · noted, not filed: useObjectFields defaults a field def with no string type to text, so such a field takes the text arm here; a spec-valid field always declares a type, so this was not measured as reachable; adjacent to objectui#11895's field-source region
- carrier: objectui#11895's field-source change (useObjectFields) or this branch's next round · noted, not filed: neither useObjectFields (ObjectFieldInfo) nor ResourceEditPage's catalog carries multiple, so a lookup, user, select or file field declared multiple true reaches the builder as a single-value type and its is-empty check is S == null, which is well typed but reads an empty list as not empty; tags, multiselect and checkboxes are multi-value by type and are right. The list filter builder documents the same type-only limit.
